question: To create a new MS Word document, which of the following steps is correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**File Tab → New**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To create a new MS Word document, you need to follow the steps: **File Tab → New**.
 
• This action opens a new blank document or allows you to select from various templates.
 
• The **File Tab** is located at the top-left corner of the MS Word interface.
 
• After clicking on the **File Tab**, a menu appears where you can select the **New** option to create a new document.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In addition to creating a new document, the **File Tab** also provides options like Open, Save, Print, and more.
 
• The **New** option allows users to select from various pre-designed templates or start with a blank document.
 
• MS Word offers various templates such as resumes, letters, reports, and more to help users get started quickly.
 
• Using templates can save time and ensure that documents have a professional appearance.
